title: Symbotic says Walmart has committed an additional $6B over several years to deploy Symbotic's supply-chain automation technology across its distribution network (Sanskriti Shekhar/Reuters)
summary: Sanskriti Shekhar / Reuters: Symbotic says Walmart has committed an additional $6B over several years to deploy Symbotic's supply-chain automation technology across its distribution network — Symbotic (SYM.O) said on Thursday it had expanded its agreement with Walmart (WMT.O), with the retailer committing about $6 billion …
